meta.title: Check your staff list for free — without uploading it
meta.description: Open your staff Excel or CSV file and see how ready you are for a labour inspection. Everything runs in your browser and the file is never sent anywhere.

checkfile.title: Check your staff list without sending it anywhere
checkfile.intro: Open your Excel or CSV file and Tesuch shows how ready you are for an inspection. Everything runs on this page, in your browser.

privacy.title: The file is never uploaded.
privacy.body: The check runs on your device, inside this page. The file does not go to a server and we cannot see what is in it. Names are not used: employees appear as codes.

checkfile.pickHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. Dates are enough: start of work, end of probation and end of contract.

error.empty: We found no employee rows in the file. Make sure the first row has column headings.
error.tooMany: The file has too many rows: 2000 at most.
error.unreadable: We could not read the file. Try saving it as .xlsx or CSV.
error.noStart: We could not find a start-date column. Add one or download the template.

result.title: Result
result.read: Read {staff} employees from {rows} rows in the file.
result.advisory: The rules are still being reviewed by a lawyer, so every issue is advisory. This is not legal advice.

status.clear: No known issues in what Tesuch checks

statusHint.clear: Nothing urgent in the data of this file, in the areas Tesuch checks. Not a guarantee of the inspection result.
statusHint.attention: There are issues worth fixing soon.
statusHint.risk: There are many issues, or a deadline has already passed. Start with the most important.

issues.title: What we found
issues.none: No issues found in the data of this file.

errors.title: Rows not checked: {n}
errors.hint: A value in these rows is not understood, so they were skipped. Fix them in the file and open it again.

missing.title: These columns are not in the file
missing.hint: Rules that depend on them were not checked. That does not mean everything is fine there.

cta.title: Stay ready
cta.body: Sign up and Tesuch checks this list every night, warns you in time and prepares the “Inspector is here” pack.

coverage.note: Not a guarantee of the inspection result. A real inspection covers more than these areas.
